in.super built-up: allowed only as a secondary labelled figure, never the price basis

us.church: allowed only as a factual named landmark in an address, never as a benefit

defect_terms.note: Condition problems are recorded (B1 defects, with the photo) and NEVER marketed. Word-boundary, case-insensitive regex fragments. B1 quarantines observations that match, B6 rejects copy that matches, CAPTION_DEFECT BLOCKs export. v1.5: bare 'water' was too blunt: on 253 Brindle it quarantined 'Indoor salt water pool and spa', the listing's lead special. Water now matches only as damage (water damage, water stains, standing water, wet basement); damage, stain and leak still match on their own.

qa_prompt_negative_block: no people, no vehicles, no animals, no extra windows, no extra floors, no text, no logos, no signage, no lights turning on, no change of time of day or weather, no fire, no water, no fireworks, no new furniture, no moved furniture, the building in the reference image stays exactly as photographed

preflight_rules.when: market=in AND (facts.status in [new_launch, under_construction, coming_soon]) AND compliance_context.rera_project is empty
preflight_rules.message: New or under-construction project cannot be advertised without a RERA registration number (RERA s.3).

preflight_rules.when: market=in AND compliance_context.is_brokered AND compliance_context.rera_agent is empty
preflight_rules.message: Brokered listing without an agent RERA number. Add it or accept the risk.

preflight_rules.when: market=in AND any on-screen area figure without the label 'Carpet area' OR facts.area_basis != carpet AND the figure is used as price basis
preflight_rules.message: Only carpet area may be used as the price basis in Indian advertising.

preflight_rules.when: market=in AND 'luxury' appears in any copy AND facts.luxury_criteria is empty
preflight_rules.message: 'Luxury' without objective criteria.

preflight_rules.when: market=in AND compliance_context.rera_project set AND cta_card.compliance_lines lacks RERA number OR portal
preflight_rules.message: RERA number and portal must be inside the frame, legible, not in the caption.

preflight_rules.when: market=us AND any banned_phrases.us match in any card, caption or post text (exact) OR phrase_scan flags coded language
preflight_rules.message: Fair Housing coded or preference language.

preflight_rules.when: market=us AND a school is mentioned with any rating adjective
preflight_rules.message: Schools may be named, never rated.

preflight_rules.when: market=us AND hook.generation_path != free_2p5d AND (disclosure_overlay missing OR cta_card lacks the altered-image line)
preflight_rules.message: Digitally altered exterior needs an on-screen label and an originals link (NAR SoP 12-5, CA AB 723).

preflight_rules.when: market=us AND compliance_context.originals_url is empty
preflight_rules.message: No originals URL for the altered-image disclosure. Required in CA, best practice everywhere.

preflight_rules.when: market=us AND 'Equal Housing Opportunity' not in cta_card.compliance_lines
preflight_rules.message: Equal Housing Opportunity line missing.

preflight_rules.when: market=us AND facts.brokerage empty
preflight_rules.message: Brokerage name missing from CTA.

preflight_rules.when: B0[hook.source_photo_id].flags.people_present
preflight_rules.message: Hook source photo contains people.

preflight_rules.when: hook.scores.asset_fit == 0
preflight_rules.message: Chosen hook needs an asset the pool lacks.

preflight_rules.when: hook.concept_id == block_build AND (property_type in [apartment, penthouse] OR observed floors > 3)
preflight_rules.message: Block build fails on towers and multi-floor buildings at cheap engine rates.

preflight_rules.when: hook.concept_id == unveiling_flyover
preflight_rules.message: Flyover reads as real footage. Heavy label required.

preflight_rules.when: hook.truth_lock missing OR frames < 8
preflight_rules.message: Every generated hook must end on the unaltered source photo.

preflight_rules.when: Q1 or Q2 failed twice for this hook and no fallback was run
preflight_rules.message: Hook QA failed twice. Switch to the fallback concept.

preflight_rules.when: any interior shot source is a generated clip, UNLESS INTERIOR_MOTION=veo AND that clip passed interior Q2 AND the segment carries the motion disclosure label
preflight_rules.message: Interiors are real photos unless an approved, labelled camera-glide clip replaces the still. A generated interior without a passing QA or a label never exports.

preflight_rules.when: listing_truth.flags.staging_suspected_any AND no 'Virtually staged' label in captions
preflight_rules.message: Photos look virtually staged. Add the label or confirm they are real.

preflight_rules.when: any card text or post_caption number or feature has no claims_trace entry OR format in [price_improved, sold_social_proof] without prior_price or sale_date
preflight_rules.message: Every claim must trace to a listing fact.

preflight_rules.when: any selected shot photo has flags.people_present
preflight_rules.message: People in a listing photo. Fair Housing imagery risk in US; misrepresentation risk anywhere.

preflight_rules.when: primary master aspect != 9x16
preflight_rules.message: Reels letterbox 16:9. 16:9 should be the derivative.

preflight_rules.when: total_length_s < 12 OR > 40
preflight_rules.message: Outside the 12 to 40s window.

preflight_rules.when: track_id not in licensed library
preflight_rules.message: Track not in the licensed library.

preflight_rules.when: two reels share concept_id AND tier
preflight_rules.message: Two reels will look the same.

preflight_rules.when: sum(hook.est_cost.total_usd) > 3.0
preflight_rules.message: Job estimate exceeds $3.

preflight_rules.when: any card bounding box outside safe_zone_9x16
preflight_rules.message: Text inside the Reels UI overlay zone.

preflight_rules.when: any card, caption, CTA line, post_caption or hashtag matches defect_terms
preflight_rules.message: Property defects, damage and repairs never appear in reel copy.

preflight_rules.when: a caption about a room sits on a shot whose room_class is a different room, or a whole-property fact sits on a single room
preflight_rules.message: A caption must sit on a shot of the room it describes.

free_2p5d.desc: canvas + ffmpeg only, no model call

reverse_conceal.desc: VERIFIED Sept 2026. For any concept where a theatrical object HIDES the building. Generating from a still where the building is hidden makes the model invent a different building (proven failure). Instead: condition on the REAL photo and generate the concealment FORWARD, then reverse.
steps: 1. Crop the hero to 9:16 using B0 safe_crop_9x16 BEFORE any model call. Never let the model letterbox.
2. H1 still: the END state (object fully covering the building), hero as reference. Prompt must list everything that stays unchanged: neighbours, vehicles, trees, power lines, sky, light direction.
3. H2 clip: image = the REAL cropped hero (NOT the still). Prompt describes the object DESCENDING onto / covering the building. Static locked-off camera, explicit 'nothing else in the scene moves'.
5. Truth lock: xfade 0.5s into a 1s hold of the untouched hero.
6. Q2 on first/mid/last. The theatrical object in the mid frame is EXPECTED and is never a reject.
reverse_conceal.verified_result: 2 of 2 runs preserved floors, front-window count, roof shape, colour, materials and the parked vehicle. Final frame pixel-matches the source.

still_then_clip.desc: DEPRECATED for concealment concepts. Produced a different building in testing. Keep only for concepts where the building stays visible throughout.

clip_only.desc: no still, video direct from the hero

reverse_conceal_flf.desc: reverse_conceal with BOTH ends pinned: first frame the real cropped hero, last frame the H1 concealed still. Reversed, the clip starts concealed and ends pinned on the real photograph.
reverse_conceal_flf.note: 0.24 assumes a silent off-Vertex provider. Vertex bundles audio and bills 0.40 for 8s regardless of generateAudio. Trust the ledger.

flf.desc: First and last frame both pinned stills, no reversal.

qa_rules.count_tolerance: counts drift between runs (8 vs 14 front windows on the same photo). Compare ref-vs-final WITHIN one QA call; never compare across runs or to a stored number.
fail_conditions: final frame is not the same building
final-frame count differs from the reference count in the same call
a scene element was added or removed
time of day or weather changed

render_constraints.no_drawtext: Homebrew ffmpeg 9.0.1 ships without freetype, so drawtext is unavailable. All overlays are canvas-rendered PNG sequences composited with the overlay filter. This was already the design; the environment now enforces it.
render_constraints.crop_before_generate: Always crop to 9:16 before any image or video call. A 16:9 still sent to a 9:16 endpoint gets letterboxed and ~40 percent of the paid pixels are black bars.

interior_motion.note: Opt-in (INTERIOR_MOTION=veo). Veo camera glide from the real interior photo as first frame, architecture locked by prompt and verified by interior Q2. Any change to a wall, door, window or fixture rejects the clip and that shot falls back to 2.5d. Clips are job assets: generated once, reused by every reel. Never generated during export.
interior_motion.prompt: Very slow, subtle camera drift inside this room: a slight lateral move with gentle parallax, as if a tripod eased sideways a few centimetres. The camera NEVER travels forward through the room, never approaches or passes through a doorway, and never reveals any space, room, hallway or area that is not already visible in the photograph. Whatever is seen through a doorway or window stays exactly as photographed and nothing new appears there. Locked architecture: no wall, ceiling, floor, door, window, curtain, radiator, light fixture or appliance may move, open, close, switch, change shape, change colour, be added or be removed. Lighting stays exactly as photographed; no light turns on or off. Only the camera moves.

hook_prompt_templates.h1:
Using the attached photograph of a house, produce an image of the IDENTICAL scene
in which the house itself is completely covered by {CONCEALER}.

Absolutely unchanged: neighbouring houses, parked vehicles, trees, power lines, sky, light direction, roof shape, window count, siding colour and material.
Do not change the camera angle, focal length, framing or crop.
Do not add, remove or move any object in the scene.
Do not alter the time of day or the direction of the light.
Only the house is covered. Everything else is pixel-identical to the source.
hook_prompt_templates.h2:
Static locked-off camera on a tripod. The camera does not move, pan, zoom or shake.

Over 8 seconds, {CONCEALER_VERB} until the house is completely covered,
ending exactly as the final frame.

Nothing else in the scene moves. No people. No vehicles move. No animals.
No text, no logos, no graphics appear at any point.
The neighbouring buildings, trees, power lines and sky are static and unchanged.
hook_prompt_templates.preserve_list: neighbouring houses, parked vehicles, trees, power lines, sky, light direction, roof shape, window count, siding colour and material
